name: Algeria urban and suburban bus lines
alternateName: Lignes de bus urbaines et suburbaines d'Algérie
description: Reviewed urban/suburban release: 73 ETUSA Lines (50 from the retained registry plus 23 whose identity comes from the evidenced OSM operator match alone, chiefly the 6xx/7xx suburban network the registry never listed), 8 official ETUS Sidi Bel Abbès Lines, 7 current ETUS Tiaret Lines, 5 official ETUS Béjaïa Lines, 5 official ETUSTO Lines, 5 official ETUS Setif Lines, 4 official ETUS M'Sila Lines and 1 ETUS Mostaganem Line. Setif Line identities and Arabic endpoints come from official 2026 Operator artwork; Lines 101, 104 and 106B have reusable OSM geometry reconciled to the announced identities. Lines 105 and 106A remain directory-only because no current public geometry was found. Béjaïa Line identity, endpoints, typed stop counts and service hours come from the Operator API and linked timetable panels; Sidi Bel Abbès identities, endpoints and complete directional departures come from supplied official network/timetable HTML; M'Sila identities, endpoints and stop counts come from official route diagrams. Operator-controlled map geometry remains validation-only. OSM supplies reusable geometry where available. Shapes are available for 58 ETUSA, 7 Tiaret, 3 Tizi Ouzou, 3 Setif and 1 Mostaganem Lines. An OSM-identified Line carries source "osm", no published termini, and links every relation its shape was assembled from so a wrong route can be reported or corrected at the origin. Excludes stale Tiaret ref 33 plus unresolved, taxi, cross/inter-wilaya, unmatched Setif, ETUAD and validation-only geometry.
